title: Forge — AI coding copilot that has read your whole repo
description: A light, spring-animated landing page for an AI coding assistant. The hero is an X-ray lens you drag over a code file to see what Forge knows about each line: callers, thrown errors, missing cases and untested branches. A pinned story, a draggable before/after code review, an editor dock, privacy toggles and a seat calculator follow.
features: Draggable X-ray lens that reveals repo context inside a clipped circle
Lens follows the mouse, drags on touch, tours by itself when idle, with keyboard buttons
Pinned scroll story with four live product visuals
Draggable before/after comparison of a suggested refactor
Capsule privacy toggles with rolling hints
Elastic seat stepper with odometer total
